_meta.purpose: Static pricing reference for the token-cost surfaces (Phase 48). Published per-MTok prices; refreshed via normal skeleton updates, not fetched at runtime.
_meta.cache_note: Cache multipliers apply to the model's input price: reads bill at cache_read_multiplier x input; writes at cache_write_multiplier_5m (5-minute TTL) or cache_write_multiplier_1h (1-hour TTL) x input. Cache tokens dominate real agentic sessions - never drop them from a cost estimate.
_meta.tokenizer_note: Newer model families use a new tokenizer that produces roughly 30% more tokens for equivalent text (e.g. claude-sonnet-5 vs claude-sonnet-4-6). Cross-model cost comparisons must compare MEASURED token counts, never text length.
_meta.intro_note: claude-sonnet-5 has introductory pricing (intro_* fields) through intro_ends; the base fields are the standing price.
